designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1988 to provide wintering habitat for mallards, northern pintails and wood ducks in Louisiana bottomlands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

review.note: FWS page says October 2000; the refuge CCP says it was established in 1988 (Regional Director approved acquisition April 1988). Wikipedia also gives 1988.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Lake Ophelia National Wildlife Refuge was established in October 2000 with the purpose of conserving and restoring habitat for migratory birds, aquatic resources, and endangered plants and animals.
